But I didn't include the entrypoint override, so it'll run with the default KC entrypoint and start-dev? Without a start command, the default is the optimized production mode (start). `--import-realm` isn't included in the default entrypoint… actually, the default Keycloak entrypoint in the container is `kc.sh start-dev`? No — the default is start-dev in "development mode" (the image default is start-dev? let me try to remember: the official Keycloak image default is `start-dev`? The default entrypoint of the Keycloak image runs `kc.sh` with start-dev in development mode). The earlier error said "Failed to start server in (development) mode" — that's because the dev entrypoint explicitly used start-dev. The image's default command is `start-dev`. So the repro will do a dev start, but without `--import-realm`. I need to force the command with the import-realm flag and `--verbose`.

Let me stop it and fix it: add a command with `--import-realm --verbose`.
